content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I'm experiencing an issue when trying to load my program from [product_name] Web Editor. My device is communicating correctly, but during the loading process, the progress bar does not complete and I get the message "DOWNLOAD FAILED READ/WRITE ERROR IN SD CARD". I've tested several SD cards but the problem remains.

The SD card should be formatted as FAT32, with a maximum size of 32 GB. Please access the diagnostic menu on your device and check the SD card status. Can you specify which [product_name] model you are using?

analysis.insight_summary: A user is having trouble loading a program from [product_name] Web Editor to their [product_name] device using an SD card, receiving a read/write error even after trying different SD cards. Another user recommends verifying the SD card formatting and using the device's diagnostics to identify any issues and asks for the exact [product_name] model.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects a smooth process for uploading programs from [product_name] Web Editor to their device via SD card, along with clear troubleshooting steps or solutions if any problems arise.
